reason: With no `immediateDelete` flag, `deleteScheduledEmailReminder` only sets `cancelled: true` (packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:225-232), and the booking-cancel path calls it that way (handleCancelBooking.ts in the patch). The real SendGrid cancel happens only in the cron handler (packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:44-64), which runs every 15 minutes (.github/workflows/cron-scheduleEmailReminders.yml:8), so a booking cancelled after the last pass before `sendAt` still gets the email, and the next pass just deletes the past-due row (scheduleEmailReminders.ts:34-41).
